groups.source_evidence: ExperimentMFC files reference heed/hid/hood/hud; example directory includes elephant calls and sine/noise TextGrid
gaps: Filenames or isolated vowel examples do not establish speaker identity, authorization, reviewed language and target profile
No four-file independent reference/learner target/calibration protocol established
No matching reviewed human target error labels; do not silently treat test expectations or auto alignment as human gold

requested_user_materials: Two identified speakers with permitted source/origin and agreed language plus supported reading profile
Four distinct recordings per pair: reference target, learner target, independent reference calibration and independent learner calibration
For each calibration, at least three manually delimited tokens for every protocol vowel (Japanese five vowels or supported US English nine vowels); valid measured F1/F2 still required at runtime
Human IPA target/calibration intervals, annotator/review date, hash binding; target correctness judgments and rationale (no automatic fake annotations)
PCM WAV files and JSON annotations matching the empty template; all paths contained in a corpus directory
Explicit normalization settings; utterance pitch is not a full independent speaker-pitch calibration
For future accuracy claims, an agreed evaluation protocol, feature-specific gold labels, sufficient positive/negative cases and human review of false positives/negatives
